name: Drowned Silence

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The silence makes two Claw attacks.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. Once on each of the silence's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 13. *Failure:* The target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn.
weldedRiders: Once on each of the silence's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 13. *Failure:* The target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the silence takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Close as Breath
Traits.text: The silence is Invisible to any creature more than 5 feet away from it; a creature within 5 feet of it can see it normally.
Traits.clause: is impossible to see until it is close enough to touch you

Traits.name: Fen Veil
Traits.text: While the silence is in mire, reeds, or standing water, the silence is Heavily Obscured and leaves no track or ripple for a pursuer to follow.

lore: Born where a drowned killing was left for the mire to hide, it is a shrouded, gangling horror whose hide drinks light and memory alike, dragging the curious into the fen one silent touch at a time.
